lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured 2D grid of circular high-luminance spots is observed posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five parallel horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a well-defined checkerboard-like arrangement where spots occupy the grid intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, each defined by a sharp vertical pixel gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette displays a sparse, irregular distribution of high-luminance spots, with the highest concentration appearing near the posterior margin and the lower basal region.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a distinct pattern characterized by a high density of small, randomly distributed high-luminance spots, contrasting with the more structured grid-like patterning on the primary flank.
